name: Bissau Velho
subtitle: Bissau Velho is the old colonial core of the capital.

facts.label: Facades
facts.value: After independence, owners were required by law to repaint facades each December for a decade

facts.label: Colonial buildings
facts.value: Most roads are still lined with buildings from the Portuguese colonial period

facts.label: Condition
facts.value: Many structures are abandoned and crumbling

parts.text: Bissau Velho is the old colonial core of the capital. Many of its colonial buildings still stand but are abandoned and crumbling.
